svg.text: Triply-periodic minimal surfaces: the zero level set of a trigonometric field
k = 2*pi/wavelength, so `wavelength` is the unit-cell side in world units — the manufacturing-facing parameter.
Blue is the solid phase (F < 0); orange is the zero isosurface. The Lidinoid's +0.15 constant shifts the level set to the minimal surface proper — PicoGK uses the same convention.
